concept.title: Product A: Clinical Overview
concept.shortdesc: Product A is an innovative oncology drug designed to treat various types of cancer.

conbody.p: Product A is an oral medication that targets specific molecular pathways in cancer cells, leading to their inhibition or elimination.

section.title: Mechanism of Action
section.p: Product A works by selectively inhibiting the activity of key oncogenic proteins, thereby reducing cancer cell proliferation and survival.
The drug's mechanism of action is characterized by its ability to:

ul.li: Inhibit the activity of oncogenic kinases.
Impede angiogenesis, thereby reducing blood supply to tumors.
